summary: Review A audit of Phase 4 (Next.js 16.4.6 patch) on branch security/next-16-4-6, phase_base_sha 837755eaa, audited HEAD 3aca2726f515201d804da75b2d159c25cd107efe. HEAD matches the audited SHA and the tree is clean. (1) Eleven app manifests and packages/api declare next 16.4.6; overrides.next is 16.4.6; the lockfile diff holds 12 removed keys and 10 added keys, all next-family except the two recorded transitive moves (caniuse-lite 1.0.30001799 to 1.0.30001819, baseline-browser-mapping 2.10.38 to 2.11.33); no other package version changed. (2) The Red rewrites keep test meaning: the 73-row ledger fingerprint, the fail-closed absent-ledger rows, the pin-at-or-above-floor rule with a below-floor failure row, and the image-size ABSENT_BY_DESIGN row with a 2.0.2-still-fails row cannot pass on nothing; the two skipped rows are exactly the PM-approved local-log rows. (3) Spot-checks at the base copy confirm the predates-track evidence: reading-advantage check-types reproduces exactly 14 errors at base, Postgres is down so the science ECONNREFUSED is environmental, and the storytime fixture is absent in both trees while no app source file changed in the range. (4) Live storytime and www-reading-advantage next builds both print Next.js 16.4.6 with no SecurityFatalError. (5) The plan claims nothing beyond the evidence; every exit-code claim I re-ran matched. No blocking finding.
nonblocking_findings: N1 (evidence gap, minor): The lockfile diff also re-serializes the deprecated field of @smithy/core@3.25.1 (same version, block-scalar reformat). The plan task 4.2 says 'No other package version changed', which is literally true, but the lockfile summary does not name this content-only byte change. No version or resolution changed; the change is inert.

N2 (wording, minor): Plan task 4.2 says the 22 changed pairs are all next-family members. The 10 added keys are all next-family; the 12 removed keys include caniuse-lite@1.0.30001799. The two transitive moves are named correctly in the next sentence, so the record is recoverable; only the first sentence is imprecise.

N3 (loose auxiliary check): tests/security-upgrade-verification-ledger.test.ts checks the plan with a substring (plan.includes('not run in CI')). Any occurrence passes. The check sits behind the exact 73-row fingerprint row, so it cannot produce a vacuous pass on its own. A future row could pin the PM decision sentence instead.

The two skipped rows are it.skipIf rows at tests/security-upgrade-p2-adversarial.test.ts:1006 and :1137, gated on LOCAL_MASTER_LOGS and LOCAL_PASS_LOGS. measure/runs/security_upgrade_20261026/p2/ is absent in this worktree, so both skip. These are the two local-log rows of the PM decision of 2026-11-18. No other skipIf exists in the five test files.

A4 fail-closed: tests/security-upgrade-verification-ledger.test.ts:673 throws reason=ledger_file_absent when the ledger is missing; the fingerprint row (lines 686-703) throws on an absent ledger and pins rows.length to 73 with the exact package|check|class|log fingerprint, so a lost row, a changed class, or a changed log path fails. The p2-adversarial rows assert exactly 13 predates rows and exactly 58 pass rows, so a missing ledger yields zero rows and fails.

Red-first proof: git show 837755eaa:apps/<each>/package.json holds "next": "16.4.1" for all eleven apps, so the task 4.1 row 'every app and the lockfile resolve next at 16.4.5 or later' failed before the bump and passes after it. The live row also fails on an empty app set (apps=0) and an empty lockfile set (lockfile=0) by code in evaluateNextPatchFloor.

image-size ABSENT_BY_DESIGN: git show 837755eaa:pnpm-lock.yaml holds no image-size@ packages key (grep count 0); only the override reference 'image-size: 2.0.3' exists. The guard row keeps both advisory ids and the 2.0.3 floor with requirePresent: false, and the new row proves image-size@2.0.2 still fails the floor (tests/security-upgrade-version-guard.test.ts, 'keeps the image-size 2.0.3 floor for a copy that returns').

Pin-at-or-above-floor rewrite: checkGuardList now fails only a pin below a floor row, and the new row 'fails a required pin that sits below its floor' feeds next=16.4.0 and expects failure (tests/security-upgrade-adversarial.test.ts). The absent-row rule fails any requirePresent:false row whose package is not in ABSENT_BY_DESIGN, proven by the synthetic sharp row.
